text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Um...
I had my first dream of the new year.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that, it was a rather unpleasant dream.
It was just a dream, so maybe I shouldn't let it bother me, though.

At the start of the Senior Year,
Narita Top Road suddenly began talking
about her first dream of the new year.
choice_data_list: What kind of dream did you have?
What kind of dream was it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Well, the thing is...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I was walking somewhere dark.
That was probably...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"I think it's a tunnel.
There's a light way off in the distance..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I'm trying to head for the exit, but I just can't seem to reach it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
And I woke up before I could reach it.
That's all it was, really.

Perhaps dreams hold no meaning.
Yet, I felt as though I had seen a similar scene before.
That was—

The red-carpeted underground tunnel to the track.
When was that, again...?
Searching through distant memories...
(Knock knock!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Huh, a guest?
In the trainer's office on New Year's Day...
I wonder who it could be.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yes, here you go.
And the person who showed up was—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: She really was here.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san...! Happy
New Year. Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Wanna go for New Year's shrine visit?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh... You don't know what Hatsumode is?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be... Ayabe-san,
you came to invite me?"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...That is true, but.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'll go! Of course!
I was just about to head there anyway.
Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...You don't have to raise your voice that much.

A major change in circumstances.
And—a major change in mindset.

Having decided to continue her racing career,
Admire Vega's mindset seemed to change considerably.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I hope that this year, along with Ayabe-san and Opera O-chan,
I can continue to be one of the Umamusume hailed as the Big Three.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
And—I swear.
I will keep working just as hard as those two.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: What did you wish for, Ayabe-san?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: The thing is... I can't think of anything.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Can't think of anything?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Yes, until last year...
I made wishes for *her* sake...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Still, things are a little different now.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Is that so...
Hmm, it really is difficult, isn't it?
choice_data_list: Why not make a wish for your own future?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Mine...?
choice_data_list: Yeah, that's what everyone usually does.
Yeah, because that's what everyone usually does.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Indeed. Ayabe-san's dedication to constantly praying for someone else is wonderful, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I think it's more natural to wish for something for yourself.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Then I will tell you
what I'm beginning to see...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
May I hone my running even further.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I want to see worlds I don't know.
A tomorrow I've never experienced before...
Saying so, Admire Vega offered a prayer. She still didn't seem used to wishing for a future for herself.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Ayabe-san, let's spend
the whole day having fun together.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I want to see lots of Ayabe-san's smiles!
What kind of fun things would you like to do?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Even if you ask me what kind...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Trainer, what should I do?

New Year's games with Narita Top Road and
Admire Vega. What might get them excited is...
choice_data_list: Relaxing and chatting in the room

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Relaxing in the room, just chatting...
That sounds nice. It's not often I get to unwind with Ayabe-san.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: What do you think, Ayabe-san?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Sure, but... Well then...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Wanna come to my room? At the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure?
Well then, if you insist!

And so, Narita Top Road was invited
over to Admire Vega's room—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Wah... How unexpected... Ayabe-san bringing friends along...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
No, no, please take your time.
Hmm-hmm-hm-hmm~♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah, what's sitting beside
Ayabe-san's bed is...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Dumbbells and a hand grip...
These are training tools for home use, right?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yeah, because it's handy to have.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...It's bland and boring, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Fufu, ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Wh-What?
So suddenly...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"You have the exact same things as me.
Dumbbells are really convenient, aren't they?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
We might actually be
more alike than we thought.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Um... Yeah. I suppose that might be part of it...

Afterward, the two relaxed in their room
and enjoyed a friendly chat together.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Karuta! That sounds great! Alright Ayabe-san,
let's go play Umamusume Karuta.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Um... when the first phrase is read,
you grab the matching second phrase, right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Reader
text_block_list.text: "On a peaceful spring day, bathed in the soft, eternal light~."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, I know this poem!
The second half should be...
Alright, I'll beat Ayabe-san to it!)

text_block_list.name: Reader
text_block_list.text: Oho...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Heh!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(Ayabe-san...?! So fast!!
She heard just one syllable of the second line and snatched it up!)
(Smack!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: It was... practically simultaneous, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it makes for great exercise.
Let's keep this up right to the very end.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yes! I won't lose to you, Ayabe-san!

Afterward, the two of them focused all their senses
and enjoyed playing karuta.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "Harajuku wei-yo"...? Does that mean going to Harajuku and greeting people like a party animal?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Shall we give it a try, Ayabe-san?
I'm sure we'll see a whole new world.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Though I know way too little about it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
For now, let's just go and check it out.
It might actually be fun.
And so, the three of them went all the way to Harajuku.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, there are so many pedestrians. I wonder
if it's always this crowded.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Ayabe-san.
It's "Way yo," okay? "Way yo."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ready, and!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: It's Ayy-Yo!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: H-Huh, once more...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: It's Ayy-Yo!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Because it's embarrassing...
In the end, we couldn't bust out the "Way-yo!" together, but walking through the downtown district gave us plenty of experiences we normally wouldn't have had.
